name: Absolvers Backgrounds

origin.name: Killer Instinct
origin.text: Aggression and fury fuelled your aspirant trials. You overcame every challenger with bloody-minded savagery, impressing your betters.

origin.name: Courage
origin.text: You faced every aspirant trial with grit and determination, pushing through exhaustion, fear, and uncertainty with conviction and bravery.

origin.name: Cunning
origin.text: You made your way through the aspirant trials by using your experience with the underhanded, relying on wit over brawn.

accomplishment.name: Crusader
accomplishment.text: You zealously shouldered a personal responsibility to destroy a particular foe; your Chapter has given you leave to continue your grim work.

accomplishment.name: Badge of Honour
accomplishment.text: You risked your immortal life to rescue mortals in peril, and have been justly recognised for your unasked for selflessness.

accomplishment.name: Cleanse and Purge
accomplishment.text: You fought enemy forces in their blasphemous lair. Some of your battle-brothers died in the conflict, but you ensured the mission was a success.

goal.name: Advancement
goal.text: You desire the honour of a special role in your Chapter. You look for opportunities to show your worth to your battle-brothers.

goal.name: Vengeance
goal.text: Many of your battle-brothers were slain by a particular foe; you burn to avenge this stain on your honour.

goal.name: Honour the Chapter
goal.text: You uphold the Chapter's valour, quick to extoll its virtues, never allowing a slight against your battle-brothers to go unanswered,

objectives: Dedicate a victory to the memory of the events at Yellem.
Mark your name in the Book of Absolution.
Clarify your duty — or lack thereof — in the current circumstances.
Complete a fallen battle-brothers unfulfilled vow.
Ruminate on the prophecy of your Sanguine Vision.
note: The Origin, Accomplishment and Goal rows repeat the Adeptus Astartes Backgrounds (Core p.72); only the Objectives differ. Copied as printed: Honour the Chapter ends with a comma, and Objective 5 reads "battle-brothers unfulfilled" without an apostrophe.
